Echoes of Change#385.dst: Empecemos por las buenas. Hemos evaluado bien cada una de nuestras rutas de huida y las hemos ordenado de más a menos preferible..
Echoes of Change#385.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#386.src: That's good. With that, we should have completed all the necessary preparations for the festival... then what are the bad news?
Echoes of Change#386.dst: Bien. Con eso deberíamos tener listos todos los preparativos necesarios para el festival... ¿y las malas noticias?
Echoes of Change#386.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#387.src: We've learned of a third Sovereign who will be present at the festival. A new one, by the name of Tasim.
Echoes of Change#387.dst: Hemos sabido de un tercer Soberano que estará en el festival. Uno nuevo, llamado Tasim.
Echoes of Change#387.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#388.src: Oh, great. As if having both Sovereigns Zhiraok and Soosu to deal with wasn't bad enough... and now there's another one?
Echoes of Change#388.dst: Ah, genial. Como si tener que lidiar con los Soberanos Zhiraok y Soosu no fuera bastante malo... ¿y ahora hay otro?
Echoes of Change#388.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#389.src: This doesn't change anything. We'll proceed as planned.
Echoes of Change#389.dst: Esto no cambia nada. Seguiremos según lo previsto.
Echoes of Change#389.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#390.src: Er... with all due respect, we'd stand no chance facing three Sovereigns wielding the Queen's blessing. I doubt we could even defeat one!
Echoes of Change#390.dst: Eh... con todo respeto, no tendríamos ninguna opción contra tres Soberanos con la bendición de la Reina. ¡Dudo que pudiéramos vencer a uno!
Echoes of Change#390.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#391.src: We have all the necessary steps prepared. We know what we need to do. The plan doesn't involve facing the Sovereigns at all - the only target is Her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#391.dst: Tenemos listos todos los pasos. Sabemos qué hacer. El plan no implica enfrentarse a los Soberanos: el único objetivo es Su Majestad.
Echoes of Change#391.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#392.src: Syndra... I agree with the young ones. It's incredibly risky, and the risk factor has only increased. Perhaps we... wait for next year?
Echoes of Change#392.dst: Syndra... estoy de acuerdo con los jóvenes. Es tremendamente arriesgado, y el riesgo solo ha aumentado. ¿Quizá... esperamos al año que viene?
Echoes of Change#392.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#394.src: Yes, the outlook of this fight is not great. Yes, the odds are against us. As I have said previously, I will be the face of the operation.
Echoes of Change#394.dst: Sí, el panorama de esta lucha no es bueno. Sí, las probabilidades están en contra. Como ya dije, yo seré la cara de la operación.
Echoes of Change#394.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#395.src: I will deal the final blow, and I alone will draw the wrath of the crown and the people. The rest of you will work from the shadows. No one will even know you're involved.
Echoes of Change#395.dst: Yo daré el golpe final, y solo yo atraeré la ira de la Corona y del pueblo. Los demás trabajaréis desde las sombras. Nadie sabrá siquiera que estáis implicados.
Echoes of Change#395.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#396.src: Syndra, old friend... are you certain your judgement isn't... clouded? I understand your troubled history, I do... but is it worth burning yourself to ash? What would Eli-
Echoes of Change#396.dst: Syndra, vieja amiga... ¿seguro que tu juicio no está... nublado? Entiendo tu pasado doloroso, de verdad... pero ¿merece la pena reducirte a cenizas? ¿Qué diría Eli-
Echoes of Change#396.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#397.src: Enough, Quill. My judgment is clear. I do not believe an additional Sovereign changes anything. Now, are you still ready to proceed?
Echoes of Change#397.dst: Basta, Quill. Mi juicio es claro. No creo que un Soberano más cambie nada. Y ahora, ¿seguís dispuestos a continuar?
Echoes of Change#397.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#398.src: ... Well, the explosives are already made and ready... so I guess we might as well use 'em.
Echoes of Change#398.dst: ... Bueno, los explosivos ya están hechos y listos... así que supongo que más vale usarlos.
Echoes of Change#398.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#400.src: After seeing the state of our citizens today... we've waited long enough. I'm ready to take action.
Echoes of Change#400.dst: Después de ver hoy cómo están nuestros ciudadanos... ya hemos esperado bastante. Estoy listo para actuar.
Echoes of Change#400.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#401.src: So long as Zeph joins, I'm in.
Echoes of Change#401.dst: Si Zeph se apunta, yo me apunto.
Echoes of Change#401.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#402.src: Wh- what? Why w- wo- would my choice matter to you...? Uh, an- anyway, I already pr- pro- promised to help Syndra, no m- matter what.
Echoes of Change#402.dst: ¿Q- qué? ¿Por qué te im- im- importa mi decisión...? Eh, e- en fin, ya pr- prometí ayudar a Syndra, pa- pase lo que pase.
Echoes of Change#402.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#403.src: Sigh. Fine, I'm outvoted. But I don't like this.
Echoes of Change#403.dst: Suspiro. Vale, me habéis ganado por votos. Pero no me gusta.
Echoes of Change#403.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#406.src: I am fighting. But I will not allow you to take the fall for it entirely by yourself.
Echoes of Change#406.dst: Voy a luchar. Pero no permitiré que cargues tú sola con todo.
Echoes of Change#406.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#407.src: You don't need to protect me, Mora. This is my decision, and-
Echoes of Change#407.dst: No necesitas protegerme, Mora. Esta es mi decisión, y-
Echoes of Change#407.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#408.src: And my decision, Syndra, is to follow you into battle.
Echoes of Change#408.dst: Y mi decisión, Syndra, es seguirte al combate.
Echoes of Change#408.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#411.src: That will be all I ask from most of you. Try to rest and relax before tomorrow's festival. I'll do a final briefing before we head out in the morning.
Echoes of Change#411.dst: Eso es todo lo que pido a la mayoría. Intentad descansar antes del festival de mañana. Haré una última reunión antes de salir por la mañana.
Echoes of Change#411.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#412.src: {u}, I have one final request to make of you. I'd like to duel you again... this time, I'll give it my all, and I expect the same of you.
Echoes of Change#412.dst: {u}, tengo una última petición. Quiero volver a batirme contigo... esta vez daré todo lo que tengo, y espero lo mismo de ti.
Echoes of Change#412.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#413.src: Meet me by the north-eastern tracks.
Echoes of Change#413.dst: Te espero en las vías del noreste.
Echoes of Change#413.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#414.src: My water magic has gotten a lot better. I will help, no matter what!
Echoes of Change#414.dst: Mi magia de agua ha mejorado mucho. ¡Ayudaré, pase lo que pase!
Echoes of Change#414.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#416.src: U-uh, yeah. I was just a-about to go there myself.
Echoes of Change#416.dst: E-eh, sí. Justo i-iba a ir yo también.
Echoes of Change#416.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#417.src: I- I can't rest now. I n-need to practice.
Echoes of Change#417.dst: N- no puedo descansar ahora. N-necesito practicar.
Echoes of Change#417.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#418.src: All things considered, I am excited to find out how my explosives will perform.
Echoes of Change#418.dst: Con todo, tengo ganas de ver cómo funcionan mis explosivos.
Echoes of Change#418.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#420.src: I hope Yus' tech doesn't let me down...
Echoes of Change#420.dst: Ojalá el aparato de Yus no falle...
Echoes of Change#420.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#421.src: I have a really bad feeling about tomorrow. Syndra better know what she's doing.
Echoes of Change#421.dst: Tengo muy mal presentimiento sobre mañana. Más vale que Syndra sepa lo que hace.
Echoes of Change#421.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#422.src: Resistance will always come with a cost. I just hope the cost isn't too great.
Echoes of Change#422.dst: La resistencia siempre tiene un precio. Ojalá no sea demasiado alto.
Echoes of Change#422.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#423.src: Meet up with Syndra for your duel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#423.dst: Reúnete con Syndra para el duelo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#424.src: We don't know what tomorrow will hold. We might succeed without any issues - and I really, truly hope that'll be the case.
Echoes of Change#424.dst: No sabemos qué traerá mañana. Puede que lo logremos sin problemas, y de verdad, de verdad espero que sea así.
Echoes of Change#424.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#425.src: However... We need to be ready for anything. That's why I want to challenge you.
Echoes of Change#425.dst: Sin embargo... tenemos que estar listos para todo. Por eso quiero desafiarte.
Echoes of Change#425.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#426.src: Of everyone here, you and I are the closest to the power level of a Sovereign. If we can each hold our own in this duel... we might stand a chance.
Echoes of Change#426.dst: De los que estamos aquí, tú y yo somos los más cercanos al nivel de un Soberano. Si los dos aguantamos este duelo... quizá tengamos opciones.
Echoes of Change#426.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#427.src: As I said, I won't be holding back. I expect you to do the same.
Echoes of Change#427.dst: Como dije, no me contendré. Espero lo mismo de ti.
Echoes of Change#427.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#428.src: ... I haven't told you the most important part of my plan yet, have I?
Echoes of Change#428.dst: ... Aún no te he contado la parte más importante de mi plan, ¿verdad?
Echoes of Change#428.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#429.src: I've said that I'll deal the final blow on Her Majesty. In order to do that... I will use my blessing from above, and kill her in one strike.
Echoes of Change#429.dst: He dicho que yo daré el golpe final a Su Majestad. Para eso... usaré mi bendición de arriba y la mataré de un solo golpe.
Echoes of Change#429.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#430.src: I'll let everyone else know tomorrow morning... But do you understand why I need this duel? I... I need to be certain I can do it.
Echoes of Change#430.dst: Se lo diré a todos mañana por la mañana... Pero ¿entiendes por qué necesito este duelo? Yo... necesito estar segura de que puedo hacerlo.
Echoes of Change#430.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#431.src: Alright. When you're ready, speak to me again, and we shall proceed.
Echoes of Change#431.dst: Bien. Cuando estés listo, háblame de nuevo y empezamos.
Echoes of Change#431.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#434.src: Alright. Let the best soldier win!
Echoes of Change#434.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#436.src: Truthfully, I didn't expect to be able to best you. You've been able to hone your skills and train your magic far more than I ever could have.
Echoes of Change#436.dst: La verdad, no esperaba poder vencerte. Has podido pulir tus habilidades y entrenar tu magia mucho más de lo que yo jamás habría podido.
Echoes of Change#436.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#437.src: So many years... and the solution was right in front of me. But I didn't know to look!
Echoes of Change#437.dst: Tantos años... y la solución estaba delante de mí. ¡Pero no supe mirar!
Echoes of Change#437.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#438.src: ...it doesn't matter now. We've come this far already. We'll have to work with what we have.
Echoes of Change#438.dst: ...ahora ya da igual. Hemos llegado hasta aquí. Tendremos que arreglarnos con lo que tenemos.
Echoes of Change#438.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#439.src: Listen... there is one other reason I asked for this. I have... something of a hard truth I need to share, and I need you to keep it to yourself.
Echoes of Change#439.dst: Escucha... hay otra razón por la que te lo pedí. Tengo... una verdad dura que contar, y necesito que te la guardes.
Echoes of Change#439.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#440.src: There is a significant chance I will fail to land the initial strike. If that happens... I will not make it out of that confrontation alive.
Echoes of Change#440.dst: Hay bastantes probabilidades de que falle el primer golpe. Si eso pasa... no saldré viva de ese enfrentamiento.
Echoes of Change#440.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#441.src: A battle with Her Majesty is no fight at all. How could it be? Could any one person make a dent in such overwhelming strength?
Echoes of Change#441.dst: Una batalla con Su Majestad no es batalla alguna. ¿Cómo iba a serlo? ¿Podría una sola persona hacer mella en una fuerza tan aplastante?
Echoes of Change#441.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#442.src: This pile of trash has a strong stench of alcohol and other... unpleasantries.
Echoes of Change#442.dst: Este montón de basura apesta a alcohol y a otras... cosas desagradables.

Echoes of Change#443.src: This must be the underwater route Yulie was talking about...
Echoes of Change#443.dst: Esta debe de ser la ruta submarina de la que hablaba Yulie...

Echoes of Change#444.src: Second Division - Stationed by the gate to the {p}. Low risk - will assist in case of commotion.
Echoes of Change#444.dst: Segunda División - Apostada junto a la puerta al {p}. Riesgo bajo - acudirá si hay alboroto.

Echoes of Change#445.src: - Tip! Hover over a piece and it will tell you its shape.
Echoes of Change#445.dst: - ¡Consejo! Pasa el cursor por una pieza y te dirá su forma.

Echoes of Change#446.src: ... So I must do this alone. If anyone must take the fall, it *will* be me.
Echoes of Change#446.dst: ... Así que debo hacerlo sola. Si alguien ha de cargar con ello, *seré* yo.
Echoes of Change#446.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#447.src: Because there is no other choice! Because if I am forced to bear yet another year without her by my side, then... then... then I think my spark would finally go out.
Echoes of Change#447.dst: ¡Porque no hay otra opción! Porque si me obligan a soportar otro año más sin ella a mi lado, entonces... entonces... creo que mi chispa se apagaría para siempre.
Echoes of Change#447.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#449.src: I suppose I may as well tell you. An anger without context must seem strange to an outside observer.
Echoes of Change#449.dst: Supongo que más vale que te lo cuente. Una rabia sin contexto debe de parecer extraña desde fuera.
Echoes of Change#449.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#450.src: I was once in the military, as you know. But I was no mere soldier, no... I'd risen so far as to approach Her Majesty's inner circle. One of her Wings.
Echoes of Change#450.dst: Estuve en el ejército, como sabes. Pero no era una simple soldado, no... Ascendí casi hasta el círculo íntimo de Su Majestad. Una de sus Alas.
Echoes of Change#450.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#451.src: You know, that was the year after Sovereign Selium died. The position for Sovereign of the {p} had opened up. If things had gone differently, could I have...?
Echoes of Change#451.dst: ¿Sabes? Fue el año siguiente a la muerte del Soberano Selium. El puesto de Soberano de {p} había quedado libre. Si las cosas hubieran ido de otro modo, ¿habría podido...?
Echoes of Change#451.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#452.src: Maybe that's why she did it. She was always sending me on difficult assignments, but...
Echoes of Change#452.dst: Quizá por eso lo hizo. Siempre me mandaba a misiones difíciles, pero...
Echoes of Change#452.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#453.src: This time, I was ordered to deal with several cursed ones in the Roughworks. Capture if possible, but... well, they wouldn't always come quietly.
Echoes of Change#453.dst: Esa vez me ordenaron ocuparme de varios malditos en Roughworks. Capturarlos si era posible, pero... bueno, no siempre venían por las buenas.
Echoes of Change#453.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#454.src: I've done this before, of course. So I wouldn't have thought much of it, except... except, one of the names I received... I recognized it. Of course I recognized it.
Echoes of Change#454.dst: Ya lo había hecho antes, claro. Así que no le habría dado importancia, salvo... salvo que uno de los nombres que recibí... lo reconocí. Claro que lo reconocí.
Echoes of Change#454.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#456.src: I refused! Of course I did - I was asked to kill the love of my life!!
Echoes of Change#456.dst: ¡Me negué! Claro que sí: ¡¡me pedían matar al amor de mi vida!!
Echoes of Change#456.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#457.src: She wasn't even cursed. And here and now, we understand the truth of that label... but back then, it was a shock! A normal, working citizen...
Echoes of Change#457.dst: Ni siquiera estaba maldita. Hoy entendemos la verdad de esa etiqueta... ¡pero entonces fue un shock! Una ciudadana normal, trabajadora...
Echoes of Change#457.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#458.src: I was brought back to the citadel. As I stood before Her Majesty, she told me it was a test. A TEST!! A test of my loyalty to the crown.
Echoes of Change#458.dst: Me llevaron de vuelta a la ciudadela. Ante Su Majestad, me dijo que era una prueba. ¡¡Una PRUEBA!! Una prueba de mi lealtad a la Corona.
Echoes of Change#458.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#459.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to the {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#459.dst: Deshonrada, me quitaron rango y posición. Me desecharon, me enviaron a {p}, sin permiso para salir.
Echoes of Change#459.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#460.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#460.dst: Deshonrada, me quitaron rango y posición. Me desecharon, me enviaron a {p}, sin permiso para salir.
Echoes of Change#460.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#461.src: Of course he knew! Offered condolences and helped get me back up once he became Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#461.dst: ¡Claro que lo sabía! Me dio el pésame y me ayudó a levantarme cuando se hizo Soberano.
Echoes of Change#461.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#462.src: He gave me an assignment. To infiltrate the local resistance groups, and keep an eye on them. If I did that... I could restore my honour.
Echoes of Change#462.dst: Me dio un encargo. Infiltrarme en los grupos de resistencia locales y vigilarlos. Si lo hacía... podría recuperar mi honor.
Echoes of Change#462.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#463.src: Ironically, it's thanks to him that we're here right now. But I can't ever forgive him for standing by and letting the crown keep me trapped there.
Echoes of Change#463.dst: Irónicamente, gracias a él estamos hoy aquí. Pero nunca podré perdonarle que se quedara mirando mientras la Corona me tenía atrapada allí.
Echoes of Change#463.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#464.src: ... But he isn't important. Not really. It's who he serves.
Echoes of Change#464.dst: ... Pero él no importa. No de verdad. Importa a quién sirve.
Echoes of Change#464.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#465.src: Her Majesty... I need her to die. I need to do it myself. Only then, can I finally be at peace...
Echoes of Change#465.dst: Su Majestad... necesito que muera. Necesito hacerlo yo. Solo entonces podré por fin estar en paz...
Echoes of Change#465.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#466.src: {u}. If I don't survive... I need you to do something for me.
Echoes of Change#466.dst: {u}. Si no sobrevivo... necesito que hagas algo por mí.
Echoes of Change#466.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#467.src: Keep my children safe. They're all I have left.
Echoes of Change#467.dst: Mantén a salvo a mis niños. Es lo único que me queda.
Echoes of Change#467.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#468.src: ... Try and get some rest. We have a massive challenge ahead of us tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#468.dst: ... Intenta descansar. Mañana nos espera un desafío enorme.
Echoes of Change#468.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#470.src: I did... When we first got into contact with Quill, I asked him to find her.
Echoes of Change#470.dst: Lo hice... Cuando contactamos con Quill, le pedí que la buscara.
Echoes of Change#470.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#471.src: And... he did. But... she didn't recognize him. She didn't... remember me.
Echoes of Change#471.dst: Y... lo hizo. Pero... ella no lo reconoció. No se... acordaba de mí.
Echoes of Change#471.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#472.src: Ha... knowing she was still alive past that wall, but that I could never see here again, and that she didn't even... remember me...?
Echoes of Change#472.dst: Ja... ¿saber que seguía viva al otro lado de ese muro, pero que nunca podría volver a verla, y que ni siquiera... se acordaba de mí...?
Echoes of Change#472.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#474.src: I tried sending her letters, with Quill's help. I don't know if any of them ever reached her.
Echoes of Change#474.dst: Intenté enviarle cartas, con ayuda de Quill. No sé si alguna llegó a sus manos.
Echoes of Change#474.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#476.src: It doesn't matter now. It's been... {~} years. Nearly half of my whole life. So long as she's safe... that's all that matters.
Echoes of Change#476.dst: Ahora ya da igual. Han pasado... {~} años. Casi la mitad de mi vida. Mientras esté a salvo... es lo único que importa.
Echoes of Change#476.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#477.src: And if we succeed tomorrow... then...
Echoes of Change#477.dst: Y si mañana lo logramos... entonces...
Echoes of Change#477.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#478.src: Then... maybe we can finally be at peace. Together.
Echoes of Change#478.dst: Entonces... quizá podamos por fin estar en paz. Juntas.
Echoes of Change#478.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#479.src: It was... during a larger assignment. I'd risen through the ranks of the military at a rapid pace, becoming a Wing only three years after joining.
Echoes of Change#479.dst: Fue... durante una misión más grande. Había subido de rango muy rápido en el ejército, y me hice Ala solo tres años después de entrar.
Echoes of Change#479.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#480.src: In {~} IA, Her Majesty was looking into more long-term solutions for managing the {p}. She requested a team of Wings most suited to the task, and I was selected for it.
Echoes of Change#480.dst: En el {~} IA, Su Majestad buscaba soluciones más duraderas para gestionar {p}. Pidió un equipo de Alas idóneo para la tarea, y me eligieron a mí.
Echoes of Change#480.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#481.src: We worked to establish a more centralized management structure... I ended up taking charge, and was later promoted to Captain.
Echoes of Change#481.dst: Trabajamos para crear una estructura de gestión más centralizada... Acabé al mando y luego me ascendieron a Capitana.
Echoes of Change#481.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#482.src: But one of my first ideas was to go undercover and work at the factories, for a time. I believed I would be able to get a better insight into the situation that way.
Echoes of Change#482.dst: Pero una de mis primeras ideas fue infiltrarme y trabajar una temporada en las fábricas. Creía que así entendería mejor la situación.
Echoes of Change#482.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#484.src: I wasn't supposed to get attached. It was just a job, and I'd be visiting many factories...
Echoes of Change#484.dst: No debía encariñarme. Era solo un trabajo, y visitaría muchas fábricas...
Echoes of Change#484.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#485.src: But I did. And it was the best mistake of my life.
Echoes of Change#485.dst: Pero lo hice. Y fue el mejor error de mi vida.
Echoes of Change#485.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#486.src: Even after I moved on, and throughout the whole three years of that assignment, I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#486.dst: Incluso después de seguir adelante, y durante los tres años de aquella misión, seguí viéndola.
Echoes of Change#486.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#487.src: ...even after the assignment ended, and I was recalled to the Citadel... even after I was inducted into the Gendarme... I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#487.dst: ...incluso después de acabar la misión y ser llamada a la Ciudadela... incluso después de entrar en la Gendarmería... seguí viéndola.
Echoes of Change#487.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#488.src: I... never told her what I really was. I thought it would be safe, for both of us... ha. And how did that turn out...?
Echoes of Change#488.dst: Yo... nunca le dije lo que era en realidad. Creí que así estaríamos a salvo... ja. ¿Y cómo acabó eso...?
Echoes of Change#488.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#492.src: Syndra's about to give her final speech before the festival. Come on, let's get going.
Echoes of Change#492.dst: Syndra va a dar su último discurso antes del festival. Venga, vamos.
Echoes of Change#492.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#493.src: Listen to Syndra's last speech before the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#493.dst: Escucha el último discurso de Syndra antes del festival en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#495.src: Today is the day we set our plan into motion. In a few hours, the festival will begin... and that's when we'll strike!
Echoes of Change#495.dst: Hoy es el día en que ponemos el plan en marcha. En unas horas empezará el festival... ¡y entonces atacaremos!
Echoes of Change#495.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#496.src: I'll now be handing out assignments. They're different from yesterday's pairings, as they're focused on what we need *during* the festival.
Echoes of Change#496.dst: Ahora repartiré las tareas. Son distintas a las parejas de ayer, porque se centran en lo que necesitamos *durante* el festival.
Echoes of Change#496.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#497.src: Zeph and Yuman, you're in charge of placing and detonating the explosives. Yusanu will show you where they are.
Echoes of Change#497.dst: Zeph y Yuman, os encargáis de colocar y detonar los explosivos. Yusanu os dirá dónde están.
Echoes of Change#497.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#498.src: Rex and Yulie, you're aerial support. Take your positions on the buildings we scouted out yesterday. Provide support for everyone else as needed.
Echoes of Change#498.dst: Rex y Yulie, sois el apoyo aéreo. Ocupad vuestras posiciones en los edificios que exploramos ayer. Dad apoyo a los demás según haga falta.
Echoes of Change#498.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#499.src: Sui, Yusanu, and {u}. I want you three to stay put on a roof nearby. Once the Queen is dead, chaos is going to break out.
Echoes of Change#499.dst: Sui, Yusanu y {u}. Quiero que os quedéis en un tejado cercano. Cuando la Reina muera, estallará el caos.
Echoes of Change#499.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#500.src: I need you three to help calm down the people, and to help fight off any soldiers that oppose us.
Echoes of Change#500.dst: Necesito que ayudéis a calmar a la gente y a repeler a los soldados que se nos opongan.
Echoes of Change#500.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#501.src: Quill will remain here with the rest of the Steel Feather, and will prepare for the aftermath.
Echoes of Change#501.dst: Quill se quedará aquí con el resto de la Pluma de Acero y preparará lo que venga después.
Echoes of Change#501.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#502.src: I'm no good in a fight, I fear. I'd only slow you down on the battlefield.
Echoes of Change#502.dst: Me temo que no sirvo para pelear. Solo os retrasaría en el campo de batalla.
Echoes of Change#502.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#503.src: Mora will be lurking in the crowd, and will help me if necessary.
Echoes of Change#503.dst: Mora estará escondido entre la multitud y me ayudará si hace falta.
Echoes of Change#503.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#504.src: Finally... I'll be stationed on a building above Her Majesty. When the time is right, I will strike her down!
Echoes of Change#504.dst: Por último... yo estaré en un edificio sobre Su Majestad. ¡Cuando llegue el momento, la abatiré!
Echoes of Change#504.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#505.src: I hope you're all ready to make history. This won't be easy... but I believe we can pull through.
Echoes of Change#505.dst: Espero que estéis listos para hacer historia. No será fácil... pero creo que lo lograremos.
Echoes of Change#505.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#506.src: I cannot ensure everyone's safety. It is likely civilians will be injured, and some of us may be hurt as well... or... worse.
Echoes of Change#506.dst: No puedo garantizar la seguridad de todos. Habrá civiles heridos, y alguno de nosotros también... o... peor.
Echoes of Change#506.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#508.src: Resistance and revolution comes at a cost. We need to accept that. I... pray it will not come to that, though.
Echoes of Change#508.dst: La resistencia y la revolución tienen un precio. Hay que aceptarlo. Yo... rezo por que no llegue a eso.
Echoes of Change#508.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#509.src: Some of you are scared, nervous. You're right to be. This is dangerous, and risky... but know that I am so, so proud of each and every one of you here today.
Echoes of Change#509.dst: Algunos tenéis miedo, estáis nerviosos. Con razón. Es peligroso y arriesgado... pero sabed que estoy muy, muy orgullosa de cada uno de vosotros.
Echoes of Change#509.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#510.src: We will change Fruma for the better! We will tear down the crown's tyrannical rule, and we will free the people!!
Echoes of Change#510.dst: ¡Haremos de Fruma un lugar mejor! ¡¡Derribaremos la tiranía de la Corona y liberaremos al pueblo!!
Echoes of Change#510.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#511.src: Alright! Let us get to work! Find your teams, and meet up at your designated positions at the festival.
Echoes of Change#511.dst: ¡Muy bien! ¡Manos a la obra! Buscad a vuestros equipos y reuníos en vuestras posiciones del festival.
Echoes of Change#511.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#513.src: Meet up with your group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss before heading to the festival.
Echoes of Change#513.dst: Reúnete con tu grupo en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y hablad antes de ir al festival.

Echoes of Change#515.src: Yeah. Got an extra battery as well.
Echoes of Change#515.dst: Sí. Y una batería de repuesto.
Echoes of Change#515.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#516.src: Perfect. I left charges for you at each spot so when we get to {p} we can pick our positions.
Echoes of Change#516.dst: Perfecto. Te dejé cargas en cada punto, así que al llegar a {p} elegimos posiciones.
Echoes of Change#516.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#520.src: Rex, I've never seen a better shot. You won't miss.
Echoes of Change#520.dst: Rex, nunca he visto mejor tiradora. No fallarás.
Echoes of Change#520.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#521.src: Thank you, Yulie. I wish you the best of luck out there.
Echoes of Change#521.dst: Gracias, Yulie. Te deseo mucha suerte ahí fuera.
Echoes of Change#521.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#524.src: Syndra m- marked out some good spots for us, huh?
Echoes of Change#524.dst: Syndra nos ha ma- marcado buenos puntos, ¿eh?
Echoes of Change#524.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#525.src: She did. I'll make sure we stay out of danger! I know my way around those alleyways.
Echoes of Change#525.dst: Así es. ¡Me aseguraré de que no corramos peligro! Conozco bien esos callejones.
Echoes of Change#525.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#526.src: Thank you... But I d- don't need a babysitter! I'll be f- fine.
Echoes of Change#526.dst: Gracias... ¡Pero n- no necesito niñera! Es- estaré bien.
Echoes of Change#526.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#527.src: I know you can handle yourself. But seriously, Zeph. I'm not playing around.
Echoes of Change#527.dst: Sé que sabes cuidarte. Pero en serio, Zeph. No estoy de broma.
Echoes of Change#527.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#528.src: I need you to be safe. We can't afford to get caught here.
Echoes of Change#528.dst: Necesito que estés a salvo. No podemos permitirnos que nos pillen aquí.
Echoes of Change#528.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#529.src: I've never s- seen you this serious before...
Echoes of Change#529.dst: Nunca te había v- visto tan serio...
Echoes of Change#529.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#530.src: I'm just nervous. I've never done anything like this before.
Echoes of Change#530.dst: Solo estoy nervioso. Nunca he hecho nada parecido.
Echoes of Change#530.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#531.src: Good thing I h- have then, p- pr- princess.
Echoes of Change#531.dst: Menos mal que yo s- sí, p- pr- princesa.
Echoes of Change#531.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#532.src: Hi... are you two, um, ready?
Echoes of Change#532.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#533.src: I... ha, I'm not sure! It's... a lot, isn't it?
Echoes of Change#533.dst: Yo... ja, ¡no estoy seguro! Es... mucho, ¿verdad?
Echoes of Change#533.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#534.src: I've been worrying about this new Sovereign... Tasim. {u}, I know you... know him.
Echoes of Change#534.dst: Me preocupa este nuevo Soberano... Tasim. {u}, sé que tú... lo conoces.
Echoes of Change#534.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#535.src: It's... it's like Rex said the other day. The Sovereigns aren't our friends. If he joined the crown, then... I'm not sure we can trust him to do the right thing.
Echoes of Change#535.dst: Es... como dijo Rex el otro día. Los Soberanos no son amigos nuestros. Si se unió a la Corona... no sé si hará lo correcto.
Echoes of Change#535.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#536.src: We can't just... sit around worrying about what could happen. We need to, um, stay focused.
Echoes of Change#536.dst: No podemos solo... quedarnos preocupándonos por lo que pueda pasar. Hay que, eh, mantener la concentración.
Echoes of Change#536.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#537.src: Syndra trusts us! We need to have faith in her plan.
Echoes of Change#537.dst: ¡Syndra confía en nosotros! Hay que tener fe en su plan.
Echoes of Change#537.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#538.src: Yeah... you're right. Let's take our positions then.
Echoes of Change#538.dst: Sí... tienes razón. Ocupemos nuestras posiciones.
Echoes of Change#538.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#539.src: The map says we're supposed to be stationed on top of a building...
Echoes of Change#539.dst: El mapa dice que debemos apostarnos en lo alto de un edificio...
Echoes of Change#539.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#540.src: Head to your designated spot at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#540.dst: Dirígete a tu posición asignada en el festival en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#541.src: So... this is our spot, then?
Echoes of Change#541.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#542.src: I think so, if I read the map correctly...
Echoes of Change#542.dst: Eso creo, si he leído bien el mapa...
Echoes of Change#542.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#543.src: ... It feels weird. Just, um, standing by. Like... like we're not really, um, doing anything to, to help.
Echoes of Change#543.dst: ... Se hace raro. Solo, eh, esperando. Como... como si no estuviéramos, eh, haciendo nada para, para ayudar.
Echoes of Change#543.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#544.src: A bit... yeah. But like Syndra said, we'll be needed to help in the aftermath. Even if we're not really doing anything until then...
Echoes of Change#544.dst: Un poco... sí. Pero como dijo Syndra, nos necesitarán para ayudar después. Aunque hasta entonces no hagamos gran cosa...
Echoes of Change#544.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#546.src: What's wrong? Something caught your eye?
Echoes of Change#546.dst: ¿Qué pasa? ¿Te ha llamado algo la atención?
Echoes of Change#546.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#547.src: Oh, uh... just- it is the festival day, right? The city looks exactly the same as it did when we, um, arrived. No festivities? No stalls, no attractions?
Echoes of Change#547.dst: Ah, eh... es que- hoy es el día del festival, ¿no? La ciudad está igual que cuando, eh, llegamos. ¿No hay fiesta? ¿Ni puestos, ni atracciones?
Echoes of Change#547.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#548.src: Oh! Hahaha, you people have attractions in Auburn?
Echoes of Change#548.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#549.src: Um... yeah! Isn't that... the point of the festival?
Echoes of Change#549.dst: Eh... ¡sí! ¿No es ese... el sentido del festival?
Echoes of Change#549.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#550.src: Maybe for you. Here... well, nobody has the time for any of that. The point, for most residents, is having a day off from work.
Echoes of Change#550.dst: Para vosotros quizá. Aquí... bueno, nadie tiene tiempo para eso. Para la mayoría, el sentido es tener un día libre de trabajo.
Echoes of Change#550.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#551.src: Oh! That's... nice, I guess. A little sad, though, that that's why, ha, people get excited about it...?
Echoes of Change#551.dst: ¡Oh! Eso está... bien, supongo. Aunque ¿no da algo de pena, ja, que sea por eso por lo que se emocionan...?
Echoes of Change#551.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#552.src: Yeah, a bit. That's the Roughworks for you, though.
Echoes of Change#552.dst: Sí, un poco. Pero así es Roughworks.
Echoes of Change#552.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#556.src: Working for the crown is complicated? Helping them oppress to people of Fruma is complicated?!
Echoes of Change#556.dst: ¿Trabajar para la Corona es complicado? ¡¿Ayudarles a oprimir al pueblo de Fruma es complicado?!
Echoes of Change#556.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#557.src: Yes! I'd explain it to you, but we don't have time for it now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#557.dst: ¡Sí! Te lo explicaría, pero ahora no hay tiempo- {u}, tienes que escucharme-
Echoes of Change#557.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#558.src: Sigh. You didn't need to do that. I'm not... being forced into anything, I'm just-
Echoes of Change#558.dst: Suspiro. No hacía falta. No me están... obligando a nada, solo-
Echoes of Change#558.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#559.src: So you chose to work for the crown? Why?!
Echoes of Change#559.dst: ¿Entonces elegiste trabajar para la Corona? ¡¿Por qué?!
Echoes of Change#559.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#560.src: I... have my reasons, trust me. Look, there's no time to explain right now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#560.dst: Yo... tengo mis razones, créeme. Mira, ahora no hay tiempo de explicarlo- {u}, tienes que escucharme-
Echoes of Change#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#561.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#561.dst: Sui, ¡¿qué haces?! Solo vas a atraer más atención sobre nosotros.
Echoes of Change#561.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#563.src: If you would just let me finish... I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- I don't know how, exactly, but we know what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#563.dst: Si me dejarais terminar... Vengo a avisaros. Vuestro grupo está descubierto- no sé exactamente cómo, pero sabemos lo que planeáis hacer hoy.
Echoes of Change#563.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#565.src: It is. You need to call it off, or else-
Echoes of Change#565.dst: Lo es. Canceladlo, o si no-
Echoes of Change#565.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#566.src: ... Because we're still friends, at the end of the day. I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#566.dst: ... Porque, al final, seguimos siendo amigos. No quiero que te hagan daño.
Echoes of Change#566.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#567.src: If only you hadn't been hiding... well, it doesn't matter now. We're out of time. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#567.dst: Si no te hubieras escondido... bueno, ya da igual. Se acaba el tiempo. Si después de esto sigues a salvo... buscaré cómo contactarte.
Echoes of Change#567.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#570.src: There's... something bigger than Fruma at stake.
Echoes of Change#570.dst: Hay... algo más grande que Fruma en juego.
Echoes of Change#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#571.src: It doesn't matter. Not now, at least
Echoes of Change#571.dst: No importa. Ahora no, al menos
Echoes of Change#571.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#572.src: Of course it matters! There's real people getting hurt by the crown, and you think it doesn't matter?!
Echoes of Change#572.dst: ¡Claro que importa! ¡¿Hay personas reales sufriendo por la Corona y crees que no importa?!
Echoes of Change#572.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#573.src: That's not what I said. I... we don't have time for this. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#573.dst: No he dicho eso. Yo... no tenemos tiempo para esto. {u}, tienes que
Echoes of Change#573.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#575.src: I asked you not to. I don't need saving.
Echoes of Change#575.dst: Te pedí que no. No necesito salvación.
Echoes of Change#575.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#576.src: You being here, it's... making things harder things harder than they need to be.
Echoes of Change#576.dst: Que estés aquí está... poniendo las cosas más difíciles más difíciles de lo necesario.
Echoes of Change#576.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#577.src: Harder for you?! You're the one siding with the crown, man!
Echoes of Change#577.dst: ¡¿Más difíciles para TI?! ¡El del lado de la Corona eres tú, tío!
Echoes of Change#577.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#578.src: I...I don't have time for this right now. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#578.dst: Yo...ahora mismo no tengo tiempo para esto. {u}, tienes que
Echoes of Change#578.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#579.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#579.dst: Sui, ¡¿qué haces?! Solo vas a atraer más atención sobre nosotros.
Echoes of Change#579.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#582.src: I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised how, exactly, I don't know, but... the Crown knowns what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#582.dst: Vengo a avisaros. Vuestro grupo está descubierto; cómo, exactamente, no lo sé, pero... la Corona sabe lo que planeáis hacer hoy.
Echoes of Change#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#584.src: It is. Choose to believe me, or not, but
Echoes of Change#584.dst: Lo es. Créeme o no, pero
Echoes of Change#584.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#586.src: We're still friends, aren't we? I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#586.dst: Seguimos siendo amigos, ¿no? No quiero que te hagan daño.
Echoes of Change#586.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#587.src: If only you hadn't come after me, then... well, it doesn't matter now. You're here anyway. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#587.dst: Si no me hubieras seguido, entonces... bueno, ya da igual. Estás aquí de todos modos. Si después de esto sigues a salvo... buscaré la forma de contactarte.
Echoes of Change#587.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#588.src: Just... please, don't proceed with your plan. Find a way to stop it. I just don't want to see anyone get hurt.
Echoes of Change#588.dst: Solo... por favor, no sigáis con vuestro plan. Buscad la forma de pararlo. No quiero ver a nadie herido.
Echoes of Change#588.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#589.src: I need to go, even finding an excuse to step away for this long was difficult. Stay safe.
Echoes of Change#589.dst: Tengo que irme; ya ha sido difícil encontrar una excusa para ausentarme tanto. Cuidaos.
Echoes of Change#589.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#591.src: What- what do we do? We need to, to get a message out! Where's Syndra, we have to-
Echoes of Change#591.dst: ¿Qué- qué hacemos? ¡Hay que, que avisar a los demás! ¿Dónde está Syndra? Tenemos que-
Echoes of Change#591.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#592.src: Oh, no... I- I don't think we can. The... the festival's starting.
Echoes of Change#592.dst: Oh, no... N- no creo que podamos. El... el festival está empezando.
Echoes of Change#592.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#594.src: Citizens of the {p}, I extend my heartfelt gratitude for your remarkable attendance this year.
Echoes of Change#594.dst: Ciudadanos de {p}, os expreso mi más sincero agradecimiento por vuestra notable asistencia este año.
Echoes of Change#594.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#595.src: Together, we shall celebrate yet another year of success and prosperity!
Echoes of Change#595.dst: ¡Juntos celebraremos un año más de éxito y prosperidad!
Echoes of Change#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#596.src: Your unwavering dedication and industrious spirit are deeply valued, and I hold a profound appreciation for your contributions to the strength and glory of our province.
Echoes of Change#596.dst: Vuestra dedicación inquebrantable y vuestro espíritu laborioso son muy valorados, y aprecio profundamente vuestras contribuciones a la fuerza y la gloria de nuestra provincia.
Echoes of Change#596.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#597.src: Production quotas for this year have been successfully achieved, and I am most pleased by this accomplishment.
Echoes of Change#597.dst: Las cuotas de producción de este año se han cumplido, y este logro me complace enormemente.
Echoes of Change#597.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#598.src: However, as Fruma continues to evolve and flourish, it is imperative that we strive for greater heights.
Echoes of Change#598.dst: Sin embargo, mientras Fruma sigue creciendo y floreciendo, es imperativo aspirar a cotas más altas.
Echoes of Change#598.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#599.src: As such, we shall be raising production quotas for the coming year.
Echoes of Change#599.dst: Por ello, elevaremos las cuotas de producción del próximo año.
Echoes of Change#599.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#600.src: I have every confidence that you will continue to dedicate yourselves to the growth of Fruma.
Echoes of Change#600.dst: Tengo plena confianza en que seguiréis entregándoos al crecimiento de Fruma.
Echoes of Change#600.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#601.src: Let us now turn our attention to the year ahead, and to the improvements to the district's infrastructure that your Sovereign has prepared for your benefit.
Echoes of Change#601.dst: Volvamos ahora la mirada al año que viene y a las mejoras de infraestructura que vuestro Soberano ha preparado para vuestro beneficio.
Echoes of Change#601.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#602.src: Sovereign Soosu has been hard at work these past months, and has developed an innovative technology designed to deliver cleaner and fresher water to our people.
Echoes of Change#602.dst: La Soberana Soosu ha trabajado sin descanso estos meses y ha desarrollado una tecnología innovadora, pensada para llevar agua más limpia y fresca a nuestro pueblo.
Echoes of Change#602.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#604.src: ... I th- th- think it's time. Let's do this.
Echoes of Change#604.dst: ... C- c- creo que es la hora. Vamos allá.
Echoes of Change#604.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#606.src: What was that?! Soldiers, investigate the commotion!
Echoes of Change#606.dst: ¡¿Qué ha sido eso?! ¡Soldados, investigad el alboroto!
Echoes of Change#606.speaker: Timasca Captain

Echoes of Change#607.src: Hm? Worry not for the commotion, it is already being taken care of. Now, as I was saying...
Echoes of Change#607.dst: ¿Hm? No os inquietéis por el alboroto, ya se está atendiendo. Bien, como iba diciendo...
Echoes of Change#607.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#609.dst: Esa es la señal de Syndra...
Echoes of Change#609.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#610.src: It's now or never... For Fruma!!!
Echoes of Change#610.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#616.src: Oh, but it is. Witness, citizens, the depravity and foolhardiness of those who turn against the crown!
Echoes of Change#616.dst: Oh, pero lo es. ¡Contemplad, ciudadanos, la depravación de quienes se vuelven contra la Corona!
Echoes of Change#616.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#617.src: Terrorists seeking to threaten the safety of our people, of our province! Aiding and abetting the Cursed, daring to make an attempt on my life, as your Queen!
Echoes of Change#617.dst: ¡Terroristas que amenazan la seguridad de nuestro pueblo y provincia! ¡Cómplices de los Malditos, osando atentar contra mi vida, vuestra Reina!
Echoes of Change#617.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#618.src: We are fortunate that news of their plot reached the crown, and that our Sovereign Soosu could devise a construct to deceive them, to draw them out into the open.
Echoes of Change#618.dst: Por fortuna, la noticia de su complot llegó a la Corona, y nuestra Soberana Soosu pudo idear un constructo para engañarlos y hacerlos salir a la luz.
Echoes of Change#618.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#619.src: Sovereigns, soldiers, to arms! Hunt down any terrorists or supporters you can find!
Echoes of Change#619.dst: ¡Soberanos, soldados, a las armas! ¡Dad caza a cuantos terroristas o simpatizantes encontréis!
Echoes of Change#619.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#620.src: I should have expected you'd have some tricks left.
Echoes of Change#620.dst: Debí suponer que te quedaban trucos.
Echoes of Change#620.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#621.src: Oh, Syndra... you couldn't just stay put and leave things to rest, could you? To discard your safety, security... all for this?
Echoes of Change#621.dst: Ay, Syndra... no podías quedarte quieta y dejar las cosas en paz, ¿verdad? ¿Tirar tu seguridad, tu tranquilidad... todo por esto?
Echoes of Change#621.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#622.src: I once saw great potential in you. Your strategic mind, your dedication... a pity you had to throw it all away.
Echoes of Change#622.dst: Una vez vi un gran potencial en ti. Tu mente estratégica, tu entrega... lástima que lo tiraras todo.
Echoes of Change#622.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#623.src: Did you really believe it would be that easy to kill me? A single empowered strike? Have you forgotten who gave you that blessing in the first place?!
Echoes of Change#623.dst: ¿De verdad creías que sería tan fácil matarme? ¿Un solo golpe potenciado? ¡¿Has olvidado quién te dio esa bendición para empezar?!
Echoes of Change#623.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#624.src: What a shame, that your rage and desperation blinded you to the truth. You never stood a chance.
Echoes of Change#624.dst: Qué lástima que la rabia y la desesperación te cegaran ante la verdad. Nunca tuviste ninguna opción.
Echoes of Change#624.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#625.src: No... no, no, no... what do we do?!
Echoes of Change#625.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#626.src: Damn it... we need to stick to the plan. Take the escape routes and regroup.
Echoes of Change#626.dst: Maldita sea... sigamos el plan. A las rutas de huida y nos reagrupamos.
Echoes of Change#626.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#627.src: What?! We can't just leave her behind! We, we have to help her! She's... I can't lose her.
Echoes of Change#627.dst: ¡¿Qué?! ¡No podemos dejarla atrás! ¡Tenemos, tenemos que ayudarla! Ella es... no puedo perderla.
Echoes of Change#627.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#628.src: I know, I know! But... she knew this might happen. She told us to save ourselves first if anything goes wrong.
Echoes of Change#628.dst: ¡Lo sé, lo sé! Pero... ella sabía que podía pasar. Nos dijo que nos salváramos primero si algo salía mal.
Echoes of Change#628.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#629.src: Besides, we... what could we even do? If Syndra can't kill her, what could we possibly do? Can't you feel it? This... this pressure?
Echoes of Change#629.dst: Además, nosotros... ¿qué podríamos hacer? Si Syndra no puede matarla, ¿qué vamos a hacer nosotros? ¿No lo notas? Esta... esta presión.
Echoes of Change#629.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#630.src: Is... is that coming from her? I, I felt something similar, during the Auburn festival...
Echoes of Change#630.dst: ¿Eso... eso viene de ella? Yo, yo sentí algo parecido durante el festival de Auburn...
Echoes of Change#630.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#631.src: She's furious... we need to get out of here. Quickly, let's head for the underground river escape route!
Echoes of Change#631.dst: Está furiosa... tenemos que salir de aquí. ¡Rápido, a la ruta del río subterráneo!
Echoes of Change#631.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#632.src: Escape using the underground river at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Echoes of Change#632.dst: Escapa por el río subterráneo en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#633.src: How is this possible? Why are there, ha, guards stationed here?!
Echoes of Change#633.dst: ¿Cómo es posible? ¡¿Por qué hay, ja, guardias apostados aquí?!
Echoes of Change#633.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#634.src: I- I don't know! They must have done some last minute schedule changes, or... or...
Echoes of Change#634.dst: ¡N- no lo sé! Deben de haber cambiado los turnos a última hora, o... o...
Echoes of Change#634.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#635.src: Oh. Or they knew our whole plan. Ha... hahaha, we never stood a chance!
Echoes of Change#635.dst: Oh. O sabían todo nuestro plan. Ja... jajaja, ¡nunca tuvimos opciones!
Echoes of Change#635.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#636.src: What are we going to do now? Yusanu, where's the next closest escape route?
Echoes of Change#636.dst: ¿Y ahora qué hacemos? Yusanu, ¿cuál es la siguiente ruta más cercana?
Echoes of Change#636.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#637.src: WE HAVE VOICES OVER BY THE CAMP SITE!! Requesting backup!
Echoes of Change#637.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#638.src: Ugh, there's more voices to the west! That mean the only route left is... is... oh, no.
Echoes of Change#638.dst: Uf, ¡hay más voces al oeste! Eso significa que la única ruta que queda es... es... oh, no.
Echoes of Change#638.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#641.src: What?! That'll just take us even further into danger!
Echoes of Change#641.dst: ¡¿Qué?! ¡Eso solo nos meterá en más peligro!
Echoes of Change#641.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#642.src: Yeah, I know! But it's our only option left! We'll... we'll figure it out. Come on!
Echoes of Change#642.dst: ¡Sí, lo sé! ¡Pero es la única opción que queda! Ya... ya se nos ocurrirá algo. ¡Vamos!
Echoes of Change#642.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#643.src: Escape using the Redwood gate at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Echoes of Change#643.dst: Escapa por la puerta de Redwood en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#645.src: Hey! We need to get out, now!
Echoes of Change#645.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#646.src: There's... barely any guards around. Zeph and Yuman must've really succeeded...
Echoes of Change#646.dst: Aquí... apenas hay guardias. Zeph y Yuman lo habrán conseguido de verdad...
Echoes of Change#646.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#647.src: ...hold it. Something's wrong. They would never leave the gate unguarded...
Echoes of Change#647.dst: ...espera. Algo va mal. Nunca dejarían la puerta sin vigilancia...
Echoes of Change#647.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#649.src: You're right. We wouldn't be that obtuse. But you were.
Echoes of Change#649.dst: Tienes razón. Nosotros no seríamos tan obtusos. Pero vosotros sí.

Echoes of Change#652.src: I'll hand it to you, those were some unexpected variables you introduced for this plan of yours, but you should know how good I am at crunching the numbers.
Echoes of Change#652.dst: Os lo reconozco: introdujisteis variables inesperadas en ese plan vuestro, pero deberíais saber lo bien que se me da hacer números.
Echoes of Change#652.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#653.src: More to the point... YOU. Cursed. You just keep summing to your list of crimes! There's the Torann massacre, we can add every other soldier to the tally... And...the death of a Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#653.dst: Y más al grano... TÚ. Maldito. ¡No paras de sumar a tu lista de crímenes! Está la masacre de Torann, podemos añadir a cada soldado al recuento... Y... la muerte de un Soberano.
Echoes of Change#653.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#654.src: Let me ask. Do you know how it feels to die? Disposed of like yesterday's garbage? Do you know how exponentially more excruciating it is to feel IN REVERSE?!
Echoes of Change#654.dst: Déjame preguntarte. ¿Sabes lo que se siente al morir? ¿Desechado como la basura de ayer? ¡¿Sabes cuánto más insoportable es sentirlo AL REVÉS?!
Echoes of Change#654.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#655.src: If dealing with you quickly wasn't magnitudes of order more important, I'd give you a lesson on the topic. Consider yourself lucky, cursed!
Echoes of Change#655.dst: Si acabar contigo rápido no fuera órdenes de magnitud más importante, te daría una lección sobre el tema. ¡Date por afortunado, maldito!
Echoes of Change#655.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#656.src: What... what's going to happen with Syndra?
Echoes of Change#656.dst: ¿Qué... qué le va a pasar a Syndra?
Echoes of Change#656.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#657.src: ...an attempt on Her Majesty's life carries high consequences. Almost positive she'll be divided out...but that isn't my problem to solve.
Echoes of Change#657.dst: ...atentar contra la vida de Su Majestad tiene consecuencias altas. Casi seguro que la dividirán... pero ese no es problema mío que resolver.
Echoes of Change#657.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#658.src: Weren't you... weren't you friends?! And you're just, going to let-
Echoes of Change#658.dst: ¡¿No erais... no erais amigos?! Y vas a dejar que-
Echoes of Change#658.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#659.src: NOT ONE MORE FACTORING WORD! How much do you think I enjoy this?! Do you think I want to hunt her down like a forgotten variable?!
Echoes of Change#659.dst: ¡NI UNA PALABRA FACTORIZABLE MÁS! ¡¿Cuánto crees que disfruto con esto?! ¡¿Crees que quiero cazarla como a una variable olvidada?!
Echoes of Change#659.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#660.src: She chose to terminate our sequence! She threw that all away, used me for some irrational solution! She has as much value as any of you zeroes now!
Echoes of Change#660.dst: ¡Ella eligió terminar nuestra secuencia! ¡Lo tiró todo, me usó para una solución irracional! ¡Ahora vale lo mismo que vosotros, ceros!
Echoes of Change#660.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#661.src: So why don't we accelerate this? Without that traitor misusing her blessing... Your number's up!!
Echoes of Change#661.dst: ¿Y por qué no aceleramos esto? Sin esa traidora malgastando su bendición... ¡¡Se te acabó el número!!
Echoes of Change#661.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#663.src: I... I think I'm gonna be sick...
Echoes of Change#663.dst: Creo... creo que voy a vomitar...
Echoes of Change#663.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#664.src: He's... he's dead. Again. We beat him... again.
Echoes of Change#664.dst: Está... está muerto. Otra vez. Lo hemos vencido... otra vez.
Echoes of Change#664.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#665.src: Again?! So he was being literal about you killing him before?
Echoes of Change#665.dst: ¡¿Otra vez?! ¿Entonces hablaba en serio con lo de que ya lo mataste?
Echoes of Change#665.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#666.src: ... Okay. Okay, so... probably not down for good. Great! That's just... great.
Echoes of Change#666.dst: ... Vale. Vale... o sea que no está muerto del todo. ¡Genial! Genial.
Echoes of Change#666.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#668.src: I... I don't, um, have enough mana left to fight, anymore... s-so we should leave, before-
Echoes of Change#668.dst: Yo... ya no me queda, eh, suficiente maná para pelear... a-así que deberíamos irnos, antes de-
Echoes of Change#668.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#669.src: Uh... y- yeah, we should... get moving.
Echoes of Change#669.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#671.src: H- how...? It, it took him way longer, last time...
Echoes of Change#671.dst: ¿C- cómo...? La, la última vez tardó mucho más...
Echoes of Change#671.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#672.src: Nngh... You...miscalculated! I told you! You know how good I am at crunching the numbers! I prepared...hhhff...for this possibility!
Echoes of Change#672.dst: Nngh... ¡Has...calculado mal! ¡Te lo dije! ¡Sabes lo bien que se me da hacer números! Me preparé...hhhff...para esta posibilidad.
Echoes of Change#672.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#673.src: It was a calculated risk. Overloading the old Nasin charm... That could've broken it. But instead...my expected solution is here!
Echoes of Change#673.dst: Fue un riesgo calculado. Sobrecargar el viejo amuleto Nasin... podría haberlo roto. Pero en vez de eso... ¡mi solución esperada está aquí!
Echoes of Change#673.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#674.src: A near-instant revival! And I heard your collaborator- All out of power now. I nearly had you in round one, even. Fight all you want- it'll sum to nothing, murderer!
Echoes of Change#674.dst: ¡Una resurrección casi instantánea! Y he oído a tu compañera- ya sin fuerzas. Casi os tenía en la primera ronda. Pelead cuanto queráis: ¡sumará cero, asesino!
Echoes of Change#674.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#676.src: ...Soosu. Thank you for taking me seriously. I didn't want you involved for the danger, but with both of us... We'll solve this problem in no time. Follow my le-
Echoes of Change#676.dst: ...Soosu. Gracias por tomarme en serio. No te quería involucrar por el peligro, pero con los dos... Resolveremos esto en nada. Sigue mi ejem-
Echoes of Change#676.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#677.src: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! You... What was...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#677.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#678.src: Soosu!! Th-These are the insurgents! The murderers!! You can't be- What did they- WHAT ARE YOU HOLDING OVER HER?! Soosu, I swear, you can get out of-
Echoes of Change#678.dst: ¡¡Soosu!! ¡E-Estos son los insurgentes! ¡¡Los asesinos!! No puedes- ¿Qué te han- ¡¿QUÉ TENÉIS CONTRA ELLA?! Soosu, te lo juro, puedes salir de-
Echoes of Change#678.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#679.src: Yeah, yeah... I know. But I think I'm sick and tired of trying.
Echoes of Change#679.dst: Sí, sí... lo sé. Pero creo que estoy harta de intentarlo.
Echoes of Change#679.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#680.src: ...Soosu...you can't- I know you can be better, you can- I'll-
Echoes of Change#680.dst: ...Soosu...no puedes- Sé que puedes ser mejor, puedes- Yo-
Echoes of Change#680.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#681.src: It'll all be over soon, Z. Please... don't make me kill you again.
Echoes of Change#681.dst: Todo acabará pronto, Z. Por favor... no me hagas matarte otra vez.
Echoes of Change#681.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#684.src: Why- why are you helping us?
Echoes of Change#684.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#685.src: Just... go, Yus. You're wasting time.
Echoes of Change#685.dst: Solo... vete, Yus. Pierdes el tiempo.
Echoes of Change#685.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#686.src: But... I was the one who stole your project. Why would you...
Echoes of Change#686.dst: Pero... fui yo quien te robó el proyecto. ¿Por qué ibas a...?
Echoes of Change#686.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#687.src: Yes, Yus, I know! What does it matter why I'm helping you? Just... just take it and go. Before they realize you're here.
Echoes of Change#687.dst: ¡Sí, Yus, lo sé! ¿Qué más da por qué os ayudo? Solo... cógelo y vete. Antes de que noten que estás aquí.
Echoes of Change#687.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#689.src: Ugh, why are you so-! Fine! You - when I look at you, it's like I'm looking at myself, before... before I became this.
Echoes of Change#689.dst: ¡Ugh, por qué eres tan-! ¡Vale! Tú... cuando te miro, me veo a mí misma, antes... antes de ser esto.
Echoes of Change#689.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#690.src: Now, go! Run! Flee! Just, leave!
Echoes of Change#690.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#691.src: If... If I leave you here. You, you-
Echoes of Change#691.dst: Si... Si te dejo aquí. Tú, tú-
Echoes of Change#691.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#692.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu. I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#692.dst: Estaré bien, Yusanu. Estoy cansada de luchar. Cansada del deber. Harta de esta vida.
Echoes of Change#692.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#694.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu, I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#694.dst: Estaré bien, Yusanu, estoy cansada de luchar. Cansada del deber. Harta de esta vida.
Echoes of Change#694.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#696.src: We... we need to go, Yusanu.
Echoes of Change#696.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#698.src: Well then, Syndra the Lioness. Nothing to say in response? Has a cat got your tongue?
Echoes of Change#698.dst: Bien, Syndra la Leona. ¿Nada que responder? ¿Te ha comido la lengua el gato?
Echoes of Change#698.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#699.src: I have no words for you.
Echoes of Change#699.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#700.src: No, I suppose you were always more fond of the language of violence...
Echoes of Change#700.dst: No, supongo que siempre preferiste el lenguaje de la violencia...
Echoes of Change#700.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#701.src: You'll notice the area has been cleared. You understand what this means for you, yes?
Echoes of Change#701.dst: Habrás notado que la zona ha sido despejada. Entiendes lo que eso significa para ti, ¿verdad?
Echoes of Change#701.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#702.src: The same as always. I kill you, or I die trying.
Echoes of Change#702.dst: Lo mismo de siempre. Te mato, o muero intentándolo.
Echoes of Change#702.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#703.src: Yuman... We n- n- need to find an escape route that w- wor- works!
Echoes of Change#703.dst: Yuman... ¡T- tenemos que hallar una ruta de huida que f- fun- funcione!
Echoes of Change#703.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#704.src: Ugh, there are way more guards than we expected! We'll have to find a way to dodge them all...
Echoes of Change#704.dst: ¡Uf, hay muchísimos más guardias de los que esperábamos! Tendremos que esquivarlos a todos...
Echoes of Change#704.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#706.src: I ca- ca- can't stand this... not h- hel- helping Syndra!
Echoes of Change#706.dst: N- n- no soporto esto... ¡no a- ayu- ayudar a Syndra!
Echoes of Change#706.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#707.src: Hey, man, have faith. She'll find a way out of there! But for now, we've gotta worry 'bout ourselves, 'kay?
Echoes of Change#707.dst: Oye, tío, ten fe. ¡Ella encontrará la salida! Pero ahora hay que preocuparse por nosotros, ¿vale?
Echoes of Change#707.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#708.src: Yeah... th- thanks, Yuman. Let's k- ke- keep moving.
Echoes of Change#708.dst: Sí... g- gracias, Yuman. Si- sigamos.
Echoes of Change#708.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#709.src: Behold, citizens... the face of the insurgent group.
Echoes of Change#709.dst: Contemplad, ciudadanos... el rostro del grupo insurgente.
Echoes of Change#709.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#710.src: The two cursed ones who attacked us have been captured. However, there are still people out there who wish us harm. Please, stay on high alert!
Echoes of Change#710.dst: Los dos malditos que nos atacaron han sido capturados. Sin embargo, aún hay quien nos desea daño. ¡Por favor, permaneced muy alerta!
Echoes of Change#710.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#711.src: If you notice any suspicious behaviour, contact your local military. Together, we will prevail as a nation.
Echoes of Change#711.dst: Si veis cualquier conducta sospechosa, avisad al ejército local. Juntos prevaleceremos como nación.
Echoes of Change#711.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#712.src: But do not worry. Even such an aggressive assault from the enemy stood no chance against our might. I will ensure everyone's safety!
Echoes of Change#712.dst: Pero no os preocupéis. Ni siquiera un asalto tan agresivo del enemigo tuvo opción frente a nuestro poder. ¡Garantizaré la seguridad de todos!
Echoes of Change#712.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#713.src: Now. As punishment for attempting to assassinate me... I will execute Syndra, leader of the cursed terrorists, right here!
Echoes of Change#713.dst: Ahora bien. Como castigo por intentar asesinarme... ¡ejecutaré aquí mismo a Syndra, líder de los terroristas malditos!
Echoes of Change#713.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#714.src: Her accomplice will be imprisoned and questioned for information on the remaining insurgents.
Echoes of Change#714.dst: Su cómplice será encarcelado e interrogado para obtener información sobre los insurgentes restantes.
Echoes of Change#714.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#717.src: I don't regret anything I've done. I know Fruma will change for the better. Maybe not today, or tomorrow! But change will come.
Echoes of Change#717.dst: No me arrepiento de nada de lo que he hecho. Sé que Fruma cambiará a mejor. ¡Quizá no hoy, ni mañana! Pero el cambio llegará.
Echoes of Change#717.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#718.src: I regret that it had to come to this, Syndra... I draw no joy from your death. I wonder, whatever happened to that woman who held boundless potential within?
Echoes of Change#718.dst: Lamento que hayamos llegado a esto, Syndra... No me alegra tu muerte. Me pregunto qué fue de aquella mujer que llevaba dentro un potencial sin límites.
Echoes of Change#718.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#720.src: I will find your children, Syndra. This tantrum of yours ends here with you.
Echoes of Change#720.dst: Encontraré a tus niños, Syndra. Esta rabieta tuya termina aquí, contigo.
Echoes of Change#720.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#721.src: Now, as for those Sovereigns of mine...
Echoes of Change#721.dst: Ahora, en cuanto a mis Soberanos...
Echoes of Change#721.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#722.src: I know you, Soosu. Please, tell me what's wrong! This isn't an unsolvable problem! Don't make it so I lose two of my-
Echoes of Change#722.dst: Te conozco, Soosu. ¡Dime qué pasa! ¡No es un problema sin solución! No hagas que pierda a dos de mis-
Echoes of Change#722.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#723.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I cannot help but notice the obvious lack of captured terrorists, amidst the scene of a battle.
Echoes of Change#723.dst: Soberano Zhiraok. No puedo evitar notar la falta de terroristas capturados en plena escena de batalla.
Echoes of Change#723.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#724.src: Your Majesty!! The insurgents, they must have blackmailed Sovereign Soosu, she-
Echoes of Change#724.dst: ¡¡Majestad!! Los insurgentes chantajearon a la Soberana Soosu, ella-
Echoes of Change#724.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#725.src: Silence. You have failed me twice, now. They have bested you in combat twice, Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#725.dst: Silencio. Ya me has fallado dos veces. Te han vencido en combate dos veces, Soberano.
Echoes of Change#725.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#726.src: I- The cursed have greater cunning than I cal-
Echoes of Change#726.dst: Yo- Los malditos tienen más astucia de la que cal-
Echoes of Change#726.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#727.src: I am disappointed in your performance. You are now expressly forbidden from continuing to chase and track down these... rotten children.
Echoes of Change#727.dst: Estoy decepcionada con tu actuación. Queda expresamente prohibido que sigas persiguiendo y rastreando a esos... niños podridos.
Echoes of Change#727.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#728.src: ...I. ... ...I alone take full responsibility for this failure, Your Majesty. Bu-
Echoes of Change#728.dst: ...Yo. ... ...Yo solo asumo toda la responsabilidad de este fracaso, Majestad. Pe-
Echoes of Change#728.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#729.src: Focus yourself on maintaining {p} operations in the absence of its Sovereign, would you? You have much experience already, I'm sure.
Echoes of Change#729.dst: Céntrate en mantener las operaciones de {p} en ausencia de su Soberana, ¿quieres? Seguro que ya tienes mucha experiencia en eso.
Echoes of Change#729.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#730.dst: La...la ausencia- No- Está usted restan-
Echoes of Change#730.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#731.src: Now, stop standing there, and do something! Rally the soldiers, track down the remnants of that terrorist group still hiding!
Echoes of Change#731.dst: ¡Ahora, deja de estar ahí parado y haz algo! ¡Reúne a los soldados, da caza a los restos de ese grupo terrorista que siguen escondidos!
Echoes of Change#731.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#734.src: As for you... do you think your little games will spare you from my wrath? Attacking a fellow Sovereign, allowing these targets to escape...
Echoes of Change#734.dst: En cuanto a ti... ¿crees que tus jueguecitos te librarán de mi ira? Atacar a un Soberano compañero, dejar escapar a esos objetivos...
Echoes of Change#734.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#735.src: Bla, bla, whatever. Just get it over with. Kill me already, if I'm so worthless to you.
Echoes of Change#735.dst: Bla, bla, lo que sea. Acaba de una vez. Mátame ya, si tan poco valgo para ti.
Echoes of Change#735.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#736.src: And allow you a peaceful death? After I gave you everything, and you turned around and betrayed me?!
Echoes of Change#736.dst: ¿Y concederte una muerte apacible? ¡¿Después de darte todo y que te dieras la vuelta y me traicionaras?!
Echoes of Change#736.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#737.src: No, Soosu. You deserve no such mercy from me.
Echoes of Change#737.dst: No, Soosu. No mereces esa clemencia de mi parte.
Echoes of Change#737.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#738.src: ...every last factoring person down here is charged with conspiracy. Her Majesty demands their capture, by any and all means.
Echoes of Change#738.dst: ...hasta la última persona factorizable de ahí abajo queda acusada de conspiración. Su Majestad exige su captura, por todos los medios.
Echoes of Change#738.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#739.src: Get it done. Now. One of them must know what they did to Soo- ... I'll be questioning each of them. Personally.
Echoes of Change#739.dst: Hacedlo. Ya. Alguno tiene que saber qué le hicieron a Soo-... Los interrogaré a todos. Personalmente.
Echoes of Change#739.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
